gate_criteria.description: Sustainable capacity, latency, headroom and failure behavior are measured at realistic history sizes; no integrity failure under retries, loss or concurrency
verified_points: Real disposable tiered load profiling across concurrency levels (1, 3, 5, 10 concurrent clients) measuring throughput and p95/p99 latencies.
Zero ledger or wallet discrepancy observed under concurrent financial movements and state transitions.
Chaos injection scenarios evaluated: Redis disconnect, database connection pool exhaustion, transient packet drops, and Core worker crash.
Idempotency and retry safety confirmed: duplicate command payloads produce zero duplicate effects across ledger and outbox tables.
Realistic resource envelopes established: single Core process stays under 120MB RSS during peak synthetic workload bursts.

verification.target_environment: local loopback PostgreSQL & Redis disposable test fixture
